labels.text: List the account's artifacts, newest first.
Open an artifact in the browser: its published page, or the conversation

S24.04.needs: A signed-in AGI account (not Local mode) that has at least one artifact, and a Mac with a default web browser
S24.04.note: No picker or selectable view was found: the code prints a text list and each artifact is opened by typing its id one at a time (apps/cli/src/lib.rs:3866 and apps/cli/src/cloud/artifacts.rs:330 match this); the plan's Where to find it says not written yet, so this path comes from the code, not the plan.
steps: In a terminal, type agi artifacts list and press Return.
Look for one block per artifact: an id, the title, and [type] on the first line, then a line starting with conversation and a date.
Copy one id from the list.
Type agi artifacts open <id> with that id, replacing <id>, and press Return.
Look for your default web browser opening the artifact's published page, or the conversation it came from if it is not published.
Compare with Expected: the list shows your artifacts and the open step opens the chosen one. Repeat with another id to check each one opens.
S24.04.where: Type agi artifacts list in the terminal (the list), then agi artifacts open <id> for each artifact; in the chat REPL, type /artifacts to list and /artifacts open <id> to open
